about: Phase 12 (docs/sandbox/INTERIORS.md): an interior's look per faction style. The builder's last stage paints and finishes each part it fitted through a blueprint step's paint (a colour) and finish (a material of Materials/Surfaces.json by name), so nothing new reaches saves or the wire. style: the FactionStyle's Name or Group it is for (--gen-interior --style NAME, else the base blueprint's group; else 'default'). wall: colours a room's walls take (one per room, by its number: more than one when nothing matches); floor: the floors' material and floorColour; crewFloor: crew rooms' floor material; serviceFloor: plant rooms' (engineering, fuel); frame: stairs, ribs and frames; trim: kick plates and door frames; accent: doors; hazard: trim in hazard rooms; wear: 0 clean to 1 rusty (walls: wall panelling below 0.34, worn paint below 0.67, rusty paint above; frames: steel below 0.5, dirty steel above; kick plates rust and plant rooms' frames soot from 0.67 and 0.5); lamp: the mains lamps' colour. 'rooms' shifts a room type within the palette: tone pale (towards white), dark (towards black) or warm (towards tan), hazard: trim in the hazard colour.
